messages:
Aisha (CS): hey team, just got a ticket (RED-5812) — customer says the latency dashboard shows no tail lines (p95/p99) for the last 6h. they only see p50 and avg. attached screenshot / link. can someone triage?

matt.ops: thanks Aisha — taggin @zoe.sre and @ingrid.platform. any quick checks we should run? customer is pretty upset about not seeing tail regressions.

dashbot: panel_id=latency-service-A, query: sum:latency_ms{env:prod,svc:api} by {quantile}. Deploy window: router/v2.3 rollout at 1850001000.

zoe.sre: I can take a look. can you paste the panel query and the timespan? Also does the missing series happen for all services or just that customer route?

Aisha (CS): pasted screenshot shows service "api-ingress" and we reproduced same view in their org. Panel timespan last 6h.

matt.ops: quick checks I ran: grafana raw query returned metrics but only series keys: p50, mean, count. p95/p99 tags absent. suspect tagging/label change during collector rollout.

zoe.sre: can repro locally. running this in metrics-explorer:
```
metrics.query("latency_ms", filter={"env":"prod","svc":"api"}, group_by=["quantile"]) 
```
returns quantile=["0.5","mean","count"]; p95/p99 not present.

ingrid.platform: deploy-bot shows we rolled a collector mapping change in collector-mapper service at 1850000900 that flattened high-percentile labels to "quantile": "histogram" instead of numeric quantiles. pushing the mapping was intended for new telemetry format but looks like old dashboards expect numeric quantile labels.

zoe.sre: ack. root cause hypothesis: series label rename (quantile->histogram) rolled without aliases. dashboards query group_by quantile so p95/p99 series vanish. fast mitigation: create dashboard transformation to map histogram->quantile for panels and add alias on ingestion to populate legacy tag. longer fix: re-run mapping update to emit both labels for a grace period.

matt.ops: suggested quick mitigation: update panel query to accept either label: e.g.
```
group_by = [ if exists("quantile") then "quantile" else "histogram" ]
```
(not real code in grafana, but we can add OR filter on label)

zoe.sre: applied temporary panel override on prod dashboard (panel_id=latency-service-A) to include histogram tag. verified p95/p99 lines reappear in UI for last 24h. leaving note in dashboard history.

deploy-bot: rollout notice — collector-mapper v1.9.4 deployed at 1850000900 by ingrid.platform.

ingrid.platform: created revert PR to reintroduce dual-label emission: collector-mapper#412. plan: backfill 2 hours of legacy labels and deploy within 30m.

Aisha (CS): updated customer (RED-5812) — told them we're rolling a fix and that we can rehydrate missing series. they appreciated the quick update.

zoe.sre: after backfill + new release, verify with this query:
```
metrics.query("latency_ms", filter={"env":"prod","svc":"api"}, group_by=["quantile"]) 
// should return quantile: ["0.5","0.95","0.99","mean"]
```
will monitor for 1h.

matt.ops: monitoring — I see p95/p99 back in the live panel at 1850001275. closing for now but keeping ticket open until backfill completes.

Aisha (CS): customer confirmed lines visible. marking RED-5812 as "fix in prod". thanks all. :tada:

zoe.sre: root cause: collector label rename without dashboard aliasing. remediation: add dual-label emission (collector-mapper#412), update dashboard templates to handle both, and add a pre-deploy checklist item to verify metric label compatibility for consumers.

ingrid.platform: ticketed follow-ups: #412 (collector fix), #413 (dashboard templates), #414 (predeploy check). assigning owners.

matt.ops: nice work. lesson — schema changes need an explicit consumer compatibility step. noted. :memo:

Aisha (CS): resolving thread and leaving customer success notes.
